content:
name: CI

on:
  # Build on pushes branches that have a PR (including drafts)
  pull_request:
  # Build on commits pushed to the default branch
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read # for checkout

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
      - run: pnpm lint --format github
      - run: pnpm build

  knip:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
      - name: Run Knip
        run: pnpm knip --reporter github-actions

  test:
    needs: [build]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    name: Test ${{ matrix.runtime }} / ${{ matrix.os }} / styled-components@${{ matrix.styled-components }}
    # Keep prerelease failures non-blocking until v7 is stable.
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
        runtime: [node@lts]
        styled-components: [devDependencies, '6.1.0']
        include:
          - os: macos-latest
            runtime: node@lts
            styled-components: devDependencies
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            runtime: node@lts
            styled-components: test
            experimental: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
        with:
          runtime: ${{ matrix.runtime }}
      - name: Pin styled-components@${{ matrix.styled-components }}
        if: matrix.styled-components != 'devDependencies'
        env:
          SC_SPEC: ${{ matrix.styled-components }}
        run: |
          SC_VERSION="$(npm view "styled-components@${SC_SPEC}" version)"
          echo "Resolved styled-components@${SC_SPEC} to ${SC_VERSION}"
          grep -q '^  styled-components: ' pnpm-workspace.yaml
          sed -i -E "s|^  styled-components: .+$|  styled-components: ${SC_VERSION}|" pnpm-workspace.yaml
          sed -i '/^minimumReleaseAgeExclude:/a\  - styled-components' pnpm-workspace.yaml
          pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm test

  # Aggregates the matrix under the name the branch protection rule requires.
  # Experimental legs can't fail it: `continue-on-error` legs that fail still
  # aggregate to `success`.
  test-required:
    name: Test node@lts / ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check matrix result
        env:
          RESULT: ${{ needs.test.result }}
        run: |
          echo "Test matrix result: $RESULT"
          test "$RESULT" = success

  coverage:
    needs: [build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
      - run: pnpm test:coverage
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          name: ui-coverage
          path: packages/ui/coverage/

  storybook-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Storybook test / styled-components@${{ matrix.styled-components }}
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        styled-components: [devDependencies, '6.1.0']
        include:
          - styled-components: test
            experimental: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
      - name: Pin styled-components@${{ matrix.styled-components }}
        if: matrix.styled-components != 'devDependencies'
        env:
          SC_SPEC: ${{ matrix.styled-components }}
        run: |
          SC_VERSION="$(npm view "styled-components@${SC_SPEC}" version)"
          echo "Resolved styled-components@${SC_SPEC} to ${SC_VERSION}"
          grep -q '^  styled-components: ' pnpm-workspace.yaml
          sed -i -E "s|^  styled-components: .+$|  styled-components: ${SC_VERSION}|" pnpm-workspace.yaml
          sed -i '/^minimumReleaseAgeExclude:/a\  - styled-components' pnpm-workspace.yaml
          pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
      - name: Store Playwright's version
        id: playwright-version
        run: |
          PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION=$(pnpm --filter sanity-ui-storybook exec playwright --version | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1)
          echo "Playwright's version: $PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION"
          echo "version=${PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Cache Playwright browsers for Playwright's version
        id: cache-playwright-browsers
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: ${{ steps.playwright-version.outputs.version }}-playwright-browsers-chromium
      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        if: steps.cache-playwright-browsers.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: pnpm --filter sanity-ui-storybook exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: pnpm test:browser
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: vitest-failure-screenshots-styled-components-${{ matrix.styled-components }}
          path: apps/storybook/**/__screenshots__/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  # See `test-required`.
  storybook-test-required:
    name: storybook-test
    needs: [storybook-test]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check matrix result
        env:
          RESULT: ${{ needs.storybook-test.result }}
        run: |
          echo "Storybook test matrix result: $RESULT"
          test "$RESULT" = success
